title: Today / Planner
intro: Turn what is due into a plan you can finish. Your school deadlines stay linked to Moodle.
task_title: What do you need to do?
assumed_window: Assume {{start}}:00 to {{end}}:00 is available each day in {{zone}}. Change these hours to match your schedule.
assumed_estimates: Unestimated assignments take 60 minutes. Exam preparation takes 45 minutes per topic, at least 90 minutes. These are starting estimates.
approval_notice: Review first. The assistant saves changes only after you approve.
unallocated_capacity: {{title}} · {{minutes}} min does not fit. Adjust your time budget, estimate, or priorities.
unallocated_overdue: {{title}} · overdue. Check whether late submission is allowed and agree a recovery date. {{minutes}} min remains.
nothing_to_plan: No work fits this window. Add a task or exam, or adjust your available hours.
empty_today: A clear day starts here. Add one task, then plan a study block. Work due later appears in the week view.
empty_week: No study blocks yet. Plan my week creates a draft for you to review before saving.
empty_exams: Add an exam and its topics to start preparing before the last night.
scope_unknown: Exam scope is not confirmed. Check with your teacher.
error: Could not save this change. It may conflict with a newer plan or a changed deadline. Refresh and review again.
material_permission: These document excerpts will be sent to your configured AI provider after approval.
material_hint: Open a course file in the reader first to convert it. Then select the documents to summarize or practice.
summary_prompt: Propose a summary of the selected converted documents. Do not invent unseen content.
quiz_prompt: Propose a practice quiz from the selected converted documents.
catch_up_prompt: Review my overdue work. Separate missing submission status from confirmed missing work. Help me choose a recovery step.
exam_prompt: Help me prepare for the next exam. State what date and scope are confirmed, then propose study blocks with explicit assumptions.
plan_prompt: Plan the next seven days for this course using all-course workload to avoid conflicts. Propose a realistic plan, list assumptions, and show work that does not fit.
run_summary: Summarize the approved excerpts by topic and source.
run_quiz: Quiz me on the approved excerpts. Put the answer key after the questions.
unknown_item: Item is no longer available. Refresh before approving.
planner_unavailable: Your planner could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
agent_scope: Proposals can change this course only. Saved tasks, exams, and study times across courses help avoid conflicts. Changes always need your approval.
corrupt_records: Some planner records could not be read and were skipped. Your other plans are available. Keep a backup before repairing the database.
